name: DragDropProvider
description:
The scope of a drag and drop system. Draggables and drop zones inside it can reach each
other; it owns the drag preview, the polite live region that announces lifts, moves and
drops, and the lifecycle callbacks for every drag in it (`onDragStart` … `onDragEnd`).
Put one around a screen or the whole application; providers do not exchange items.
signature: ({ children, announcements, instructions: instructionsProp, autoScroll, ...callbacks }: DragDropProviderProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: announcements
props.description: Replace any of the screen reader messages.

props.name: autoScroll
props.description: Scroll containers and the page while a pointer drag nears their edges. Default true.

props.name: children
props.description: Everything that drags or takes drops.

props.name: instructions
props.description: The keyboard instructions every handle is described by.

props.name: onDragCancel
props.description: A drag ended without a drop; `reason` says why.

props.name: onDragEnd
props.description: Every drag's last event, after the item settled, with `outcome` "dropped" or "cancelled".

props.name: onDragMove
props.description: The pointer moved during a pointer drag (every frame). Write styles here, never React state.

props.name: onDragOver
props.description: The target zone, insertion index or the target's verdict changed.

props.name: onDragStart
props.description: An item was lifted: past the pointer threshold, after a touch press, or with Space or Enter.

props.name: onDrop
props.description: An item was dropped on a zone that accepted it, after the zone's own `onDrop`.
